newsitem.title: USA: USDA leaves butter support price unchanged in 1997.
newsitem.headline: USDA leaves butter support price unchanged in 1997.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Tuesday said its purchase price for butter will be unchanged at $0.6500 per pound in 1997, but said it will reduce its purchase price for non-fat dry milk by 1.8 cent per pound to $1.0470.
USDA's Commodity Credit Corp also said it would lower the milk support price by 15 cents to $10.20 per 100 lb as required by the farm bill.
CCC said it was maintaining the butter purchase price so that the drop in the milk support price would "have the least effect on milk prices received by producers."
